punchline: Nir Eyal taped a hundred-dollar bill and a lighter to his calendar: skip the gym, burn the bill.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal had a free gym in his own building and still skipped it. So he taped a hundred-dollar bill next to each workout on his calendar and left a cheap lighter beside it. Burn the calories or burn the bill. He says he's kept it up for over three years, gained muscle, and never burned the money. He calls it a price pact: decide while you're calm, so the lazy moment has nothing to argue with.
